questions.q: Which paths does the feature-development guide say to cover with tests first?
options: The money paths — flows users depend on
questions.why: The guide recommends covering the money paths first — the flows users depend on.

questions.q: Why does the guide recommend keeping commits small?
options: Reviewable changes get reviewed; huge ones get rubber-stamped
questions.why: Small, reviewable commits actually get reviewed, whereas huge commits tend to get rubber-stamped.

questions.q: How should the backlog be prioritized according to the guide?
questions.why: The guide says to prioritize ruthlessly by user impact, not by what's fun.
